title: Cosmic Eye Ritual
description: A surreal night scene features a giant cracked moon with three purple eyes in a starry magenta sky. Below, a massive pink octopus-like creature with a single yellow eye and lightning bolts is contained in a transparent sphere that drips vibrant pink, blue, and green liquid onto a glossy stage where three robed men stand holding scepters, surrounded by smaller glowing spheres.
prompt: A surreal cosmic ritual scene at night, giant cracked moon with three glowing purple eyes floating in a magenta starry sky with constellations. In the center a massive pink octopus creature with one large yellow eye and electric purple lightning bolts is trapped inside a huge transparent sphere. The sphere drips vibrant pink blue and green liquid onto a glossy black stage. Three men in ornate colorful robes and crowns stand on the stage holding scepters, with smaller glowing crystal balls nearby containing tiny figures. Dramatic spotlights, dripping colorful paint effects, highly detailed surreal painting style
